steps.description: Load the module, call createScene(), then immediately call updateMatrixWorld(true)

failure_patterns.reason: ❌ CRITICAL: Call root.updateMatrixWorld(true) IMMEDIATELY after createScene() and BEFORE reading any mesh.matrixWorld. Without this, matrixWorld contains stale transforms causing large geometry errors.

suggestions: Pattern: const root = createScene(); root.updateMatrixWorld(true); — must be the first two calls.

steps.description: Treat named THREE.Group nodes as parts/links — traverse the scene to collect all named groups
Assign each mesh to its nearest named ancestor group
Bake world transforms into geometry before export: applyMatrix4(matrixWorld) + toNonIndexed()

failure_patterns.reason: ⚠️ The skill-provided script 'scripts/export_link_objs.mjs' has a bug — it is missing the toNonIndexed() call after applyMatrix4(). This causes OBJExporter to produce incorrect geometry (Chamfer distance errors >1.0). Write your own export script with the correct baking pattern.

❌ CRITICAL: After applyMatrix4(mesh.matrixWorld), you MUST call toNonIndexed() if the geometry has an index. Pattern: 'geom.applyMatrix4(mesh.matrixWorld); if (geom.index) geom = geom.toNonIndexed();'. Missing toNonIndexed() causes OBJExporter to produce incorrect face indices.

❌ CRITICAL: Do NOT clone meshes and add them to a group for export. This preserves local transforms instead of baking world transforms. Correct pattern: bake geometry with applyMatrix4(matrixWorld) + toNonIndexed(), then create a temp mesh from the baked geometry.

suggestions: Baking pattern: geom = mesh.geometry.clone(); geom.applyMatrix4(mesh.matrixWorld); if (geom.index) geom = geom.toNonIndexed();
warnings: Never skip toNonIndexed() — OBJExporter silently produces wrong vertex indices with indexed BufferGeometry.

steps.description: Export per-part OBJ using deterministic (sorted) part ordering

failure_patterns.reason: ⚠️ Sort part/link names before iterating for export to ensure deterministic ordering. Pattern: 'const sortedParts = Array.from(parts.values()).sort((a,b) => a.group.name.localeCompare(b.group.name));'. Unsorted iteration is non-deterministic and causes verifier failures.

suggestions: Sort parts by group name with localeCompare before exporting to ensure consistent output.
